name: Rythu Bharosa
benefit: Investment support paid per acre for each crop season.
about: Direct bank transfer to farmers for seeds, fertilisers and other farming inputs.
note: Meant for land under cultivation. Register through your Rythu Vedika and confirm the current rules.

name: Rythu Bima
benefit: Free life insurance cover for farmers.
about: Life insurance for pattadar farmers. The amount is paid to the nominee if the farmer dies.
note: The farmer's age must be 18 to 59 years.

name: Rythu Runa Mafi (Crop Loan Waiver)
benefit: Waiver of short-term crop loans up to Rs 2 lakh per family.
about: Waives crop loans so that farmers can start fresh with new credit.
note: Covers short-term crop loans taken between 12 Dec 2018 and 9 Dec 2023. Check your status if your case is still pending.

name: Free Power for Agriculture
benefit: Free electricity for farm pump sets.
about: The State supplies electricity to agricultural pump sets free of cost.
note: Ask your local electricity (DISCOM) office about the current rules and the service connection process.

name: Interest-Free Crop Loans (Vaddi Leni Runalu)
benefit: Interest benefit on crop loans repaid on time.
about: The State pays the interest on eligible crop loans when the farmer repays within the due date.
note: Ask your bank about the loan limit and the repayment date that apply to you.

name: Farm Mechanization Subsidy
benefit: Subsidy on tractors, sprayers and other farm implements.
about: Reduces the cost of buying farm machinery under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization.
note: Priority is usually given to small and marginal farmers, SC/ST farmers and women.

name: Subsidised Seeds
benefit: Certified seeds at subsidised price.
about: Quality seeds, including green manure seeds, are supplied at a lower price through the Agriculture Department.
note: Collect seeds through your Rythu Vedika or Mandal Agriculture Officer when the supply season opens.

name: Horticulture Subsidies (MIDH)
benefit: Subsidy on saplings, mulching, shade nets, polyhouses, farm ponds and cold storage.
about: Helps farmers grow fruits, vegetables and flowers under the Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture.
note: You must own land in Telangana and have an assured source of irrigation. Subsidy rates depend on the category of farmer.

name: Oil Palm Cultivation Support
benefit: Subsidy on plants, drip irrigation and intercropping for oil palm.
about: Support for farmers who take up oil palm plantation under the National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm.
note: Drip irrigation must be installed before planting. Contact the Horticulture Officer in your mandal.

name: Micro Irrigation Subsidy (Drip and Sprinkler)
benefit: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
about: Helps farmers save water and increase yield under the Telangana Micro Irrigation Project.
note: Registration is online and compulsory: at a Mee-Seva centre or on the portal with an Aadhaar-linked mobile OTP. SC/ST farmers get a higher subsidy. Sanction depends on available funds.
docs: Small or marginal farmer certificate (if applicable)

name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Yearly income support paid in instalments.
about: Pays landholding farmer families directly into their bank accounts.
note: The bank account must be linked with Aadhaar and eKYC must be done.

name: PM Kisan Maandhan (Pension)
benefit: Monthly pension after age 60.
about: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers, where the farmer pays a small monthly amount.
note: For farmers aged 18 to 40 with up to 2 hectares (about 4.94 acres) of land.
formLabel: Enrol online for PM Kisan Maandhan

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Short-term crop loan on easy terms.
about: Gives farmers timely credit for seeds, fertiliser and other crop needs.
note: Download the form, fill it with your land and crop details, and submit it at your bank. The bank decides the loan limit.

name: Soil Health Card
benefit: Free soil testing and fertiliser advice.
about: A soil test report with crop-wise fertiliser recommendations for your land.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefit: Support for seeds, demonstrations and equipment for cereals, pulses and oilseeds.
about: Helps farmers raise production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and oilseeds.
note: Benefits are given through the Agriculture Department. Ask your Mandal Agriculture Officer.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (Organic Farming)
benefit: Support for farmers who move to organic farming in clusters.
about: Farmers form clusters and receive help with organic inputs, certification and marketing.
note: Farmers join as a group (cluster). Ask your Agriculture Officer about clusters in your area.

name: ATMA - Farmer Training and Demonstrations
benefit: Free training, field demonstrations and exposure visits.
about: Agricultural Technology Management Agency programmes teach farmers new methods and technology.
note: Contact your Mandal Agriculture Officer or the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
benefit: Loan with interest subsidy for storage and post-harvest facilities.
about: Finances cold storage, warehouses, sorting and processing units for farmers and farmer groups.
note: A project report is required. Loans are given through banks.

name: e-NAM (Online Crop Market)
benefit: Sell your produce online to buyers across India.
about: National Agriculture Market lets farmers register and sell through approved mandis for better prices.
note: Register at your nearest e-NAM mandi or on the portal.
formLabel: Register as a farmer on e-NAM

name: Dairy Milk Incentive
benefit: Incentive paid for each litre of milk supplied to the dairy cooperative.
about: Dairy farmers get an extra payment per litre of milk they supply to the cooperative.
note: The rate and payment dates are decided by the Government. Confirm with your village milk society.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (Cattle Development)
benefit: Support to improve cattle and buffalo breeds and milk yield.
about: Provides breeding services, artificial insemination and support for dairy units.
note: Benefits are given through the Animal Husbandry Department. Ask at your veterinary hospital.

name: National Livestock Mission
benefit: Subsidy to start poultry, sheep, goat or pig units and to grow fodder.
about: Helps farmers and rural youth set up small livestock businesses.
note: Many components are linked to a bank loan. Ask the Animal Husbandry Department.

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (Fisheries)
benefit: Support for fish farming, fish seed, boats and nets.
about: Helps fish farmers and fishers raise production and income.
note: Contact the District Fisheries Officer for the open components.

name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission
benefit: Support for bee colonies, boxes and beekeeping equipment.
about: Promotes scientific beekeeping as an extra income for farmers.
note: Training is usually needed before getting support. Ask the Horticulture Officer.

name: MSP Procurement of Crops
benefit: Government buys your crop at the Minimum Support Price.
about: Paddy and other notified crops are bought at procurement centres so farmers get a fair price.
note: Register your crop details with your Rythu Vedika before harvest. Only notified crops and seasons are covered.

name: National Mission on Natural Farming
benefit: Support for chemical-free natural farming.
about: Helps farmers shift to natural farming with training and local inputs.
note: Farmers usually join through clusters. Ask your Agriculture Officer.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
benefit: Support for farm projects, machinery and agri start-ups.
about: Funds agriculture projects and infrastructure through the State Agriculture Department.
note: Ask your Agriculture Officer which projects are open for farmers.

name: Indiramma Atmiya Bharosa (Farm Labour Support)
benefit: Yearly financial support for landless agricultural labour families.
about: Support for farm workers who do not own land. Enter 0 acres when you register.
note: Rules such as days of MGNREGA work apply. Confirm the current rules and last date.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Crop insurance against loss from drought, floods, pests and other notified risks.
about: Central crop insurance scheme for notified crops and eligible farmers.
note: Check with your Agriculture Officer whether PMFBY is available in Telangana for the current season.

name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
benefit: Support for soil health, water-saving and climate-friendly farming.
about: Promotes sustainable farming practices such as soil health management and efficient water use.
note: Benefits are given through the Agriculture Department. Ask your Mandal Agriculture Officer.

name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oilseeds
benefit: Support with seeds, demonstrations and inputs to grow oilseed crops.
about: Helps farmers raise oilseed production to reduce dependence on imported edible oil.
note: Covers notified oilseed crops such as groundnut, sunflower, soybean and sesame. Ask your Agriculture Officer.

name: National Bamboo Mission
benefit: Support for planting bamboo on farm land and for bamboo-based activities.
about: Promotes bamboo cultivation as an extra income crop for farmers.
note: Contact the Horticulture Officer in your mandal for the current application process.

name: PM-AASHA (Price Support for Crops)
benefit: Helps farmers get the Minimum Support Price for notified pulses and oilseeds.
about: Price support measures so that farmers receive remunerative prices for eligible crops.
note: Covers only notified crops, with limits on the quantity bought. Register before harvest.
